voices.excerpt: **Proposal** - *Observation:* The verified findings record conflicting death tolls from two news reports regarding the explosion at the Habaş steel plant in Aliağa: one reporting 12 killed (OnlineKhabar) and another reporting 17 killed (HeadTopics). Neither entry cites an official release from the İzmir Governorship or AFAD. - *Inference:* The public context indicates an unresolved discrepancy between reports of 12 and 17 fatalities, but it contains no primary documentation from Turkish authorities to confirm which figure is officially verified. - *Uncertainty:* It is unknown whether the İzmir Governorship or AFAD issued an official statement confirming either 12 or 17 deaths, or if the variance reflects developing casualty counts over time. **Concrete Test** - Execute a targeted query using the approved public-text capability against official statements from the İzmir Governorship (`izmir.gov.tr`) or AFAD (`afad.gov.tr`) concerning the Habaş (HABAŞ) steel plant explosion in Aliağa to extract the officially stated fatality count.
